TAMIL NADU SOCIAL SECURITY PENSION SCHEMES (OLD AGE PENSION / DESTITUTE WIDOW PENSION) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Financial pension assistance provided to vulnerable elderly persons, destitute widows, deserted wives, and unmarried women to ensure monthly social security and dignified living. 
 
2. 
Categories & Eligibility 
- Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS): Age 60 years and above, Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- Destitute Widow Pension (DWP): Destitute widows aged 18 years and above.
- Destitute Deserted Wives Pension (DDWP): Women deserted by husband for over 5 years, age 30 and above.
- Unmarried Destitute Women Pension: Unmarried destitute women aged 50 years and above.
 
3. 
Benefits Provided 
Rs. 1,200/- per month monthly pension credited directly via ECS / Bank account, plus free rice (20 kg per month) and free sarees/dhotis twice a year (Pongal & Diwali). 
 
4. 
Documents Required 
- Age Proof Certificate / Aadhaar Card
- Ration Card / Smart Family Card
- Income Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
- Death Certificate of husband (for Widow Pension)
- Bank Account details
 
5. 
How to Apply & Department 
- Applications to be submitted to Special Tahsildar (Social Security Schemes) / e-Sevai Center.
- Department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Social Security Schemes Wing), Government of Tamil Nadu.
